display.purpose: Monetary figures only — dashboard totals, monthly summaries. Semibold Geist, not a separate typeface.

mono.purpose: Reserved for code-like or tabular technical values.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Light-mode card resting shadow; none in dark mode.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Only elevated state in the system; paired with translateY(-1px).

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Fast table row hover fill for quick scanning.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button (save, add transaction, submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #0b6544; color: #fafafa; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d7550; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #147b55; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action, lower emphasis than primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #edeff3; color: #151d28; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e0e3e9; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Bordered low-emphasis action, e.g. filters and toolbar actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #f6f9f7; color: #151d28; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #d7dde4; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #cdf4e6; color: #084932; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content container: dashboard summary card, list group wrapper.
components.html:
Monthly Total
June 2026

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); background: #ffffff; color: #151d28; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 0; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #627084; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-amount { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.75rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #147b55; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text/number input for forms (expense amount, description).
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d7dde4; background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #151d28; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #627084; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #147b55; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Amount Badge
components.description: Signed income/expense figure — color paired with explicit sign, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-amount-income, .ds-amount-expense { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-amount-income { color: #147b55; } .ds-amount-expense { color: #ef4343; }

components.name: Table Row
components.description: Transaction/installment list row with fast hover scan feedback.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-row { transition: background-color 0.1s ease; } .ds-row:hover { background-color: rgba(98,112,132,0.08); } .ds-row td { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7dde4; }

narrative.overview: HomeLedger reads like a well-kept household ledger: quiet, precise, and legible at a glance. The palette is a single deep emerald green (#0b6544) carried through primary actions, income figures, and focus states, set against a near-white sage background with soft, barely-there radial gradients that keep the surface from feeling clinical. Numbers get the spotlight — amounts are set in semibold Geist Sans with tight tracking and tabular numerals, so the eye lands on money first and controls second without a second typeface competing for attention. This is a private household tool, not a product being sold. It explicitly rejects hero-metric SaaS dashboard clichés, gradient text, confetti or celebratory gamification around spending, and any visual noise that competes with the numbers. Motion is present but restrained: micro-interactions (button press scale, row hover, card lift) confirm interaction without ever choreographing attention away from the data.
keyCharacteristics: Single-hue emerald system: one green (#0b6544 light / #29a376 dark) carries primary, ring, and income meaning
One typeface, Geist, throughout — money figures step up to semibold weight and tight tracking rather than switching to a second face
Flat cards with barely-visible borders and shadow-sm, lifting only on hover
Full light/dark theme parity via HSL CSS custom properties

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only saturated color in the system. It marks primary action, focus, and income — nothing else earns saturated color. Red is reserved strictly for expenses and destructive/error states.

rules.name: The Weight-For-Money Rule
rules.body: Monetary amounts are marked by semibold weight + tight tracking + tabular numerals, never by a second typeface. One face, one voice — money is louder, not different.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats at rest. Shadows exist solely as hover/interaction feedback, never as a static decorative layer.

dos: Do set every monetary amount in semibold Geist with tight tracking and tabular numerals — this is the one typographic signal that a number is money.
Do keep emerald green as the only saturated color; income, primary actions, and focus rings all share it deliberately.
Do pair every income/expense color cue with a sign (+/-) or icon — color alone must never carry the meaning (WCAG AA).
Do keep cards and surfaces flat at rest; reserve shadow and lift for hover/interaction only.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for all transitions.
donts: Don't use hero-metric SaaS dashboard patterns (giant stat + small label + gradient accent).
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) anywhere.
Don't add confetti, celebration animations, or gamified feedback around spending or saving.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color; expand the emerald family instead of adding new hues.
Don't introduce a second typeface for money or anything else; one sans family, varied by weight.
Don't apply shadow or elevation to a card that isn't hovered/active.
